_help: Reverse fountain (Lightning giveaway) UI. enabled=false keeps the build byte-identical to a build without this feature: no widget, no /terms/ page, no privacy section, no footer link. The giveaway amount, budget and caps live in the Worker (wrangler.toml vars + admin endpoint), not here. api empty = use statues.json config.leaderboard_api. address_retention_days must match the Worker's FOUNTAIN_ADDRESS_RETENTION_DAYS. See FOUNTAIN.md. payout mirrors the Worker payout vars (PAYOUT_MODE, PAYOUT_SATS, PAYOUT_TIERS, PAYOUT_BONUS_SATS, PAYOUT_BONUS_WEIGHT, FOUNTAIN_CAP_SATS_DAY) and must match them: it feeds the static copy and the Official Rules page; the live widget reads the Worker's /api/fountain.
_test_page_help: Temporary hidden test statue page for the live end-to-end giveaway test (built only while this key is present and enabled is true). Not a statue: never on the map, sitemap, passport or leaderboard; noindex. Its location, radius and on/off switch live in the Worker's D1 (fountain_test_statue), never here. Remove this key, git rm -r the slug folder and rebuild after the test. radius_m is only the number shown on the page and must match the Worker's D1 radius_m.
